purpose: Supplier source inventory. Reachability is not proof of review or verification.
scope: Supplier-specific entry points plus shared source dependencies, web screens, mobile navigation and background jobs. Shared barrels conservatively include other-workspace modules.
limitations: Nonliteral dynamic imports/globs and externally wired runtime callbacks need manual discovery.
Assets and third-party dependencies are not audited by this inventory.
Plan, permission, branch, warehouse, locale and runtime matrices require separate execution evidence.
